F1: The flex item is Ember's wrapper div around `.extra-info-wrapper`, and it keeps `min-width: auto`; with the `nowrap` `.topic-link`, a long title sets the item's minimum width, so the title won't truncate and the panel gets pushed out.
F2: small-action-desc` is now a shrink-to-fit flex item with no `flex-grow`, so the edit/delete buttons floated right inside it now sit next to short text instead of at the row's right edge (755px on desktop).
